title: The Amber Room
hook: Who really stole the world's most priceless room?
headline: The missing masterpiece vanished in war

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1701 the Amber Room was begun for Charlottenburg Palace in Berlin, not commissioned by Peter the Great.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The room was installed in the Catherine Palace by 1716 in Saint Petersburg.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Nazi troops seized the Amber Room during the 1941 invasion of the Soviet Union, taking it from the Catherine Palace and moving it to Königsberg.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Its whereabouts remain unknown, though a 2016 Russian investigation suggested a hidden bunker.

end.line: Where do you think the Amber Room lies today?

description: Explore the mystery of the vanished Amber Room and the clues left behind.
